verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a communications SDK, but the evidence pack never documents a way to define rules that fire actions on events. The mentions of SIP media application Lambda configurations and their conversion to Flows do not describe an event-to-action rule engine. At most they are developer building blocks, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
